title: Relighting and grounding test bed
purpose: Compare relighting approaches on a clean, easily-keyed plate before applying a chosen method to the artist's own performance footage. Chosen because the subject wears a dark suit rather than green wardrobe, so keying is not the confounding variable.

delivery.frame_rate_note: The artist shoots 24 fps natively, so his own footage conforms exactly with no resampling. 24/1 is the project default; a shot whose source differs must record an explicit delivery.conform.

environments.status: shared with proof_of_concept; visual quality iteration pending
